@Gauss93507131 @NeilJacobs @FiredByBiden @PeterSchiff Were we under a dictatorship? No. Yet, we were not allowed to create an alternative currency. Resistance to censorship is therefore a key point (and Dogecoin is not), in addition to protection against inflation.
@Gauss93507131 @NeilJacobs @FiredByBiden @PeterSchiff I think that Bitcoin can both resist censorship and reflect its value in the price, while Dogecoin cannot. We will see with time who is right.

@Gauss93507131 @NeilJacobs @FiredByBiden @PeterSchiff Now, Dogecoin is worth a lot, if you think that in the future it will be worth more and that it can resist censorship, then it is a good investment. If you think it CANNOT resist censorship, then it is not a good investment. 2/3
